cities.name: Paris
cities.local_food_tip: Croissants, baguettes, cheese, wine, crepes — French classics in charming cafés and patisseries. 🥐🧀🍷

Afternoon: 🏰 Stroll through Montmartre, Sacré‑Cœur hill and narrow artistic streets → 🍽️ Lunch: classic French bistro dishes.

Sunset: 🌇 Seine riverbank walk or visit Eiffel Tower at golden hour for panoramic views.

Night: 🌃 Dinner in a charming brasserie, then evening strolls under city lights or a boat ride on the Seine.

🌞 Extended daylight — more time for sightseeing and river walks.
🍨 Ice‑cream, light meals and relaxed strolls after hot afternoons.
🎶 Outdoor concerts or cultural events around city squares.
🍂 Parks and avenues turn golden — beautiful scenery and photos.
🧀 Hearty meals, warm soups and comfort food as days cool down.
🏛️ Museums and indoor sites for rainy or chilly afternoons.
🎄 Christmas markets, festive lights along streets and monuments.
🔥 Hot drinks, pastries and cosy cafés after cold walks.
🏛️ Spend time inside museums, galleries or theatres on chilly days.

🚶 Many iconic sights are walkable within central zones — ideal for walking tours.
🎫 Day‑pass or multi‑day transport cards convenient for heavy sightseeing days.
🚲 Bicycles or e‑scooters can be fun for parks, riverside or short hops.
